scope: Only the original alpha=13/25 fixed field, T=1/2, original 4400-4500 spread and actual Padé output; no new alpha or other fields.

partition.overlap_rule: Each closed source cell intersecting a closed bin contributes its full certified residual upper bound; bin bound is the maximum over every such cell. Exact boundary intersections are included.

propagation: eta_time = sum_bin(R_physical_bin_upper * integral_bin xi(T-s) ds)/nu; the full fractional history is retained by the proved q*g_alpha=xi identity, with no cell restarts.
forward_weights: J0(T-a)-J0(T-b), outward 100-bit integer dyadic intervals, 64-term Mittag-Leffler series plus explicit geometric tails
accepted_eta: minimum of separately valid old eta, finite-history global eta, and fresh time-local eta for the same reference function
accepted_CF_radius: minimum of separately valid old CF radius and the exponent-to-CF bound at the accepted eta, using the same exact reference modulus
failure_policy: Report every stated budget whether passed or not; lack of certification does not prove actual error exceeds the budget. Keep all omitted finite nodes, strip, true infinite tail, arithmetic remainder and signed output-centre translation.
cost_policy: Separately disclose fresh full-field residual generation, saved-envelope checking, bin aggregation, weight generation, all 513 node propagation, and full-budget aggregation. No total-runtime superiority claim from reuse alone.
stop_policy: Produce the complete same-centre full-budget result and all budget checks; do not hide supplementary work behind an earlier stop.
input_policy: Verify byte identities of frozen fields, residuals, exponents, prices, and old shared coefficient ledgers; fresh NPZ must have full closed-time cover and all 513 original frequencies. Maximum of all fresh cells must reproduce every frozen complete residual endpoint exactly. Frozen upstream files are never modified.
